support_qa._comment: Support QA report config. Checks run in listed order; only failing checks render in a row's QA cell. Field keys refer to jira_workspaces.support_fields.

checks.name: Stalled on us
checks.rule: Waiting for support with no update in 14+ days.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 1.8h8M4 14.2h8"/><path d="M4.8 1.8v2.4c0 1.6 3.2 2.6 3.2 3.8S4.8 10.2 4.8 11.8v2.4M11.2 1.8v2.4c0 1.6-3.2 2.6-3.2 3.8s3.2 2.2 3.2 3.8v2.4"/><path d="M6.4 12.6h3.2"/></g>

checks.name: Customer gone quiet
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="1.8" y="3.4" width="12.4" height="9.2" rx="1.4"/><path d="M2.2 4.2 8 8.6l5.8-4.4"/></g>

checks.name: No customer update in 30 days
checks.rule: Waiting for support or Pending, and no team comment in 30+ days.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2.2 3.6a1.4 1.4 0 0 1 1.4-1.4h8.8a1.4 1.4 0 0 1 1.4 1.4v6a1.4 1.4 0 0 1-1.4 1.4H7l-3.2 2.8V11h-.2a1.4 1.4 0 0 1-1.4-1.4z"/><path d="M8 4.6v2.4"/><path d="M8 9h.01" stroke-width="2"/></g>

checks.name: Pending, no link
checks.rule: Pending with no linked work on another board.

checks.name: Pending, no reason
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.2"/><path d="M6.4 5.6v4.8M9.6 5.6v4.8"/></g>

checks.name: Linked work unscheduled
checks.rule: Linked delivery work is still in a To Do category (Parking lot, To Do).
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="2" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M6.2 11.6V4.6h2.6a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 0 4.2H6.2"/></g>

checks.name: Enhancement not routed
checks.rule: “Request an enhancement” 7+ days old that isn’t Pending and linked.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5.8 11.2c0-1.4-2.3-2.6-2.3-5.1a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 9 0c0 2.5-2.3 3.7-2.3 5.1z"/><path d="M6.2 13.4h3.6M6.8 15h2.4"/></g>

checks.name: Past due date
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="3.2" width="12" height="10.8" rx="1.6"/><path d="M2 6.6h12"/><path d="M5.2 1.6v3M10.8 1.6v3"/><path d="M8 8.6v2"/><path d="M8 12.4h.01" stroke-width="2"/></g>

checks.name: Ready to resolve
checks.rule: Every linked delivery item is done.
checks.svg: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.2"/><path d="M5.2 8.2l2 2 3.6-4"/></g>

verdicts.title: Ready to resolve
verdicts.cap: All linked delivery work is done; close the loop with the requester.

verdicts.title: Stalled on us
verdicts.cap: Waiting for support with no update in 14+ days, or no team comment in 30+ days. Oldest update first.

verdicts.title: Customer gone quiet
verdicts.cap: Waiting for customer for 14+ days. Nudge once, then resolve per the auto-close policy. Longest wait first.

verdicts.title: Pending without a clear path
verdicts.cap: Pending, but missing a linked delivery ticket or a Pending reason, or the linked work is still unscheduled.

verdicts.title: Enhancements not routed
verdicts.cap: Enhancement requests older than 7 days that aren’t yet Pending and linked to a delivery board.

verdicts.title: Moving, or pending the right way
verdicts.cap: Recently updated, or Pending with a reason and active linked work.

palette_extra._comment: Aging-chart dot colors, light / dark. Shared tokens come from product_qa.palette.

palette._comment: Hex values from signatry-brand-core. Light / dark pairs.

queries.jql: project in (SUP) AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY created ASC
queries.description: Every open support ticket, team-wide (deliberately not assignee-scoped).

queries.jql: project in (SUP) AND statusCategory != Done AND created <= "2026-09-25" ORDER BY created ASC
queries.description: Comments only, kept separate so the main pages stay under the connector's size limit. Newer tickets can't fail the no-team-comment rule, so they're skipped.
